ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior decision — I picked Willet because the query is a straightforward, neutral explanatory task with no harm-adjacent or extraction-specific characteristics. On those grounds I weighted general capability: Willet's higher MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 75.9) and Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 83.2) scores suggest stronger performance on clear, accessible explanation of a technical concept. Both models treat neutral transactional requests similarly in their preferences, so capability was the deciding factor.
